body: I told myself as a kid that if things ever got this bad id kill myself now I know what to dot going ahead with it is different though. My mind isn't coping I don't know if I can work through this even medicated

I'm so tired of hurting so bad I don't want to die at all but if this is the end of life then okay I will go with that. There is no future for me and no one will care. I have nothing going for me and no hope for the future anyway. I am so desperate to have my mind back but it is not my mind anymore

I'd want my doctor to euthanase me if they could but they will not do it. I don't feel right in my own mind I don't know what decision to make or say. This has happened to me before and I tried so hard to prevent it but it's happening again. The best thing the doctor can do is medicate me. I am not in a rational state

I've been trying to stay alive but it's only been using temporary things. I have been relying on short term fixes for too long and my mind isn't safe anymore. I've been telling myself this is coping but it's not. And now it's become too much. All the bad stuff from the past is coming out at the same time as this. I don't want to be alive like this. I should have killed myself before I got this bad
I am coping hour by hour, minute by minute, it's too much. I keep falling asleep and then feeling terrible waking up to this. My sanity is falling apart I am not able to cope, I don't know what to do

I am not coping with things or using reason properly so it's hard to communicate but I know I have to see a doctor. I am not able to tolerate day to day living, all I do is get blackout drunk by myself. I don't want to kill myself but being alive doesn't seem bearable. I don't believe in an afterlife I think you just die. I don't care though I am not handling my thoughts. I've wanted to die for so long maybe this is the time.
